parents.course: Digital Advertising Content, Technologies and Concepts

ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed ADV 490 Digital Advertising Content should not register for ADV 305. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. The pre-req of ADV 150 will not be enforced.
